Use headphones and a quiet room. Answer every question out loud, as in the real exam. Keep this page open until you have listened to or downloaded your recordings, because they are not saved anywhere else.
E
Describe a skill you learned that you found difficult. You should say:
  • what the skill was
  • when and how you learned it
  • why it was difficult
and explain how you feel about this skill now.
